description: Avtobusne linije v občini Postojna is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA POSTOJNA. The database contains data on bus routes in the municipality of Postojna. Coverage: OBČINA POSTOJNA. The portal shows the English title as "Bus lines in the municipality of Postojna" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA POSTOJNA. Its keywords include avtobusne linije, javni prevoz, avtobusi. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
